description: Source code for MemoryDealer class and related memory management utilities in Android's binder framework, including linked list implementation, memory allocation, and deallocation logic.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: Templatized doubly linked list implementation used for managing memory chunks.

classes.name: Allocation
classes.description: Represents a memory allocation managed by MemoryDealer, inheriting from MemoryBase.

classes.name: SimpleBestFitAllocator
classes.description: Memory allocator implementing a best-fit algorithm with support for page alignment.

classes.name: chunk_t
classes.description: Internal structure representing a memory chunk in the allocator.

methods.name: LinkedList::insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts a new node after a specified node.

methods.name: LinkedList::insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a new node before a specified node.

methods.name: LinkedList::insertHead
methods.description: Inserts a new node at the beginning of the list.

methods.name: LinkedList::insertTail
methods.description: Inserts a new node at the end of the list.

methods.name: LinkedList::remove
methods.description: Removes a specified node from the list.

methods.name: Allocation::~Allocation
methods.description: Destructor that frees the allocated memory back to the dealer.

methods.name: SimpleBestFitAllocator::SimpleBestFitAllocator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the allocator with a given size.

methods.name: SimpleBestFitAllocator::allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory of a specified size with optional flags.

methods.name: SimpleBestFitAllocator::deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory at a given offset.

methods.name: SimpleBestFitAllocator::alloc
methods.description: Internal method to find and allocate a memory chunk.

methods.name: SimpleBestFitAllocator::dealloc
methods.description: Internal method to free a memory chunk and merge adjacent free chunks.
